purpose: Evaluate public APPO Basic policies as candidate demonstration sources against the existing Jev controller.

primary.selection: Named before evaluating any APPO outcomes; do not select a checkpoint or controller on test or OOD.

primary_metric: Fraction of episodes with a positive KILLCOUNT delta before termination; report test and OOD separately.

environment.step_rule: Reuse the existing adapter, including single-tick advancement and first observed kill termination.

observation_contract.appo: Current RGB framebuffer resized to the checkpoint input; checkpoint normalization and recurrent memory are retained.
observation_contract.jev: Existing structured visible-object boxes, player variables, and two-observation history.
observation_contract.comparison_scope: End-to-end controllers with different observation representations; not an identical-input architecture comparison.

verification: Strict checkpoint state loading, including observation normalization statistics.
Confirm native action-index mapping and preprocessing against the checkpoint source.
Reset recurrent state at every episode; record raw and behavior action distributions separately.
Validate complete case coverage and independently replay recorded actions.
Report every planned checkpoint and controller; retain failures as results.
predict_position: Not covered by these Basic checkpoints.
